newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-EDDERY SPARKLES WITH FIVE WINS.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-EDDERY SPARKLES WITH FIVE WINS.

text.p: Irishman Pat Eddery, bidding for an 11th jockey's championship, was in great form at Haydock on Saturday, with five winners from six rides.
After 12-1 shot Primo Lara had given him victory in the opening race he quickly went on to complete a treble with 11-2 shot Dacha and 6-4 chance Besiege.
Eddery's form briefly deserted him in the day's feature race, the Group One Sprint Cup when he finished unplaced on Danehill Dancer. The winner was 10-1 shot Iktamal, the mount of Willie Ryan.
But he was soon back on the winning trail when Oggi obliged at 12-1 and followed up by riding Embankment home at 3-1.
Eddery, who has ridden five winners in a day on several occasions, said: "This has to be one of my favourite courses.
"When I came here today I thought I had two good chances but I was just hoping with the other ones really."
Punters who backed Eddery's mounts were rewarded at accumulative odds of 10,984-1.
